a006.noteEn: Use the wafer to orient substrate scale. This surface photograph cannot identify SOI or reveal a buried oxide; use the course cross-section for the layer structure.

a016.note: 晶圓是雷射退火的處理對象；本照片沒有雷射設備、溫度分布或摻雜活化資料，不能由顏色判定退火結果。
a016.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for laser annealing. No laser tool, temperature field or dopant-activation data is pictured; colour cannot establish an annealing result.

a024.note: 以完整晶圓對照課內 CFET 奈米截面的尺度差距；照片不是 imec 的 CFET 樣品，也不能辨認上下互補電晶體。
a024.noteEn: Compare wafer scale with the course CFET nanoscale cross-section. This is not an imec CFET sample and does not reveal stacked complementary transistors.

a027.note: 晶圓表面提供製造尺度的起點；照片沒有可驗證的技術節點資訊，不可標成次二奈米製程實拍。
a027.noteEn: The wafer surface introduces manufacturing scale. No verifiable node information is available for this image; it is not a photograph of a sub-2-nm process.

a038.note: 由晶圓上重複晶粒辨認圖案複製的尺度；OPC 修正形狀遠小於照片解析度，本圖不能驗證 OPC 成敗。
a038.noteEn: Repeated die patterns introduce the scale of pattern replication. OPC corrections are far below this photograph’s resolution; this image cannot validate OPC.

a039.note: 晶圓是成像圖案最終轉移的載體；照片沒有光罩、反向微影目標函數或模擬空中影像。請搭配本課計算流程圖。
a039.noteEn: The wafer is the substrate onto which imaging patterns are transferred. No mask, inverse-lithography objective function or simulated aerial image is pictured; use the course computation diagram.

a047.note: 晶圓照片提供電子束寫入載體的尺度背景；沒有顯示電子束柱、曝光光阻或寫入解析度。
a047.noteEn: The wafer photograph provides substrate-scale context for electron-beam writing. It does not show an electron column, exposed resist or writing resolution.

a067.note: 晶圓表面外觀作為平坦化與後續圖案製作的背景；這不是 CMP 加工中照片，光亮外觀也不能代替平坦度量測。
a067.noteEn: The wafer surface provides context for planarization and subsequent patterning. CMP is not in progress, and a reflective appearance cannot replace flatness measurement.

a068.note: 以晶圓作為漿料與磨粒作用的基板背景；照片看不到磨粒粒徑、分散性、化學組成或 CMP 去除率。
a068.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for slurry and abrasive action. The image reveals no abrasive size, dispersion, chemistry or CMP removal rate.

a106.note: 整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a106.noteEn: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a109.note: 暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a109.noteEn: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a110.note: 背磨厚度與次表面損傷要分開管理。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a110.noteEn: Control remaining thickness separately from subsurface damage. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a111.note: 隱形切割的改質層在晶片內部。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a111.noteEn: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a117.note: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a117.noteEn: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. The wafer photo provides circular-substrate/scale context, not footage of panel-level packaging. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a123.note: 背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a123.noteEn: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a072.note: ALD 是 3D NAND 高深寬比薄膜研究的相關製程；這是通用研究設備，不是 NAND 堆疊截面或記憶孔實拍。
a072.noteEn: ALD is relevant to high-aspect-ratio films in 3D NAND. This is general research equipment, not a NAND-stack cross-section or a memory-hole micrograph.

a073.note: 以 ALD 設備認識介電薄膜形成的硬體背景；照片沒有電荷捕捉層、穿隧氧化層或保持時間測試結果。

a076.note: ALD 設備對應氧化物薄膜的可控沉積概念；沒有顯示電阻切換、導電細絲或 ReRAM 耐久性量測。
a076.noteEn: The ALD tool supports the concept of controlled oxide-film deposition. It does not show resistive switching, conductive filaments or ReRAM endurance measurements.

a090.note: ALD 研究設備提供薄膜成長的比較背景；不是大面積顯示面板產線或 TFT 背板實拍，也不能直接套用晶圓設備的均勻性。

a156.note: 主動對準尋找光功率最大值而非影像中心。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。

a157.note: 被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。

a158.note: 固化收縮及熱膨脹會讓最佳對準點漂移。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。

a176.note: 光開關矩陣的路徑數增加累積損耗。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。

release.photography: 129 licensed photographs with author/license records; 11 newly verified primary-source records. Scene mappings clearly distinguish exact project photographs from representative imagery.
release.curriculum: Educational subdivisions and route branches, not a qualified manufacturing traveler.
release.demoScope: Photographic references with original projected 3D teaching equipment and ten simplified warmup models; not a calibrated or sensor-connected digital twin.
release.narrationScope: Native device speech; two authored core languages; other languages need configured translation and a matching installed voice. Text guidance is always available.
release.videoScope: A separate public HTTPS player removes academy/ChatGPT authentication from file-mode playback. YouTube, publisher, network and browser restrictions still apply.
release.researchScope: Discipline-specific research worksheets; not authored manufacturing instructions.
release.catalogScope: Curated representative topics, not a verified global top-500/top-1000 ranking; includes historical antecedents predating the last century.
release.projectVisualScope: Unique colorful geometry for all 1003 guided course icons and 20 category icons. 2066 topic icon files in total; unexpanded research topics can share geometry. 200 bilingual railway system relationship SVGs.
release.sourceVisibility: User-provided course-material index removed from the released site and offline data.
release.comparisonScope: Each guided course has authored comparisons and representative map points. Repeated institutions are not distinct fabrication sites.
release.aiRoutesScope: Configurable server-side OpenAI-compatible, Claude Messages, Gemini text/image, local Ollama CPU and explicitly loaded browser CPU text. Provider keys and large model weights are not bundled.
release.aiScope: Optional consent-based local CPU generation; models download separately. Cloud accounts require Supabase configuration; local profiles work without it.
release.billingScope: Hosted owner/demo and offline editions contain complete source; protected Python HTTPS commerce requires operator configuration. No live payment activated.
release.languageScope: 79 selectable language targets detected from browser preferences. Authored Traditional Chinese and English curricula; other full text needs configured translation, an explicitly loaded local model or supported browser translator. Completion state is reported; no claim of 79 fully reviewed offline translations.
release.computingScope: 100 focused computing/security curricula plus named quantum, acceleration, energy and resource systems. Original architectural exercises and synthetic local evidence, not deployment or industrial operating manuals.
release.opticsScope: 101 optics and precision-instrument curricula (99 new, asml and a405 extended): 8 authored units per course, each expanded into mechanism, quantitative, verification and failure-diagnosis steps. Original teaching exercises, not vendor recipes or operating procedures.
release.marketData: Weekly delayed snapshot (tools/markets-v12/update_markets.py, GitHub Action weekly-markets.yml); live TradingView chart on request.
release.structuresScope: 100 bridges-and-buildings curricula (96 new, danjiang, b003, b015 and b021 extended): 10 authored units per course, each expanded into load-path, quantitative, testing and failure-diagnosis steps, plus a dossier of key figures, timeline, codes and landmark comparisons. Original teaching exercises, not design documents, method statements or work permits.
release.lazyLoadingScope: HTML shell first; compact metadata next; only the free first stage when a visitor opens a course. Scene code/photos and resources load on demand. Authorized full courses use uncached server requests; full offline owner preview is explicit.
release.undergroundScope: 100 tunnel-and-underground curricula (97 new, hsuehshan, b102 and b103 extended): 10 authored units per course, each expanded into load-path, quantitative, testing and failure-diagnosis steps, plus a dossier of key figures, timeline, codes and landmark comparisons. Original teaching exercises, not design documents, method statements or work permits.
release.waterScope: 100 water-and-coastal curricula (97 new, three-gorges, b202 and b226 extended): 10 authored units per course, each expanded into mechanism, quantitative, verification and failure-diagnosis steps, plus a dossier of key figures, timeline, codes and landmark comparisons. Original teaching exercises, not design documents, method statements or work permits.
release.railScope: 100 rail-and-transport curricula (99 new, b301 extended): 10 authored units per course, each expanded into mechanism, quantitative, verification and failure-diagnosis steps, plus a dossier of key figures, timeline, codes and landmark comparisons.
